measures.questionText: Shall the Constitution of Georgia, for the purpose of protecting family farmland, be amended so as to increase the maximum acreage to qualify for assessment and taxation as a bona fide conservation use property from 2,000 acres to 4,000 acres?
measures.officialStatement: This proposal increases the maximum acreage to qualify for assessment and taxation as a bona fide conservation use property from 2,000 acres to 4,000 acres. It amends Article VII, Section I , Paragraph III of the Georgia Constitution , relating to uniformity, classification of property, assessment of agricultural land, and utilities, by revising subparagraph (e)(1). A copy of this entire proposed constitutional amendment is on file in the office of the judge of the probate court and is available for public inspection.

measures.questionText: Shall the Constitution of Georgia be amended so as to require that all probate court judges be elected in nonpartisan elections?
measures.officialStatement: This proposal provides that all probate judges shall be elected in nonpartisan elections. It amends Article VI, Section VII, Paragraph I of the Georgia Constitution, relating to selection and term of office of judges, by revising subparagraph (a). A copy of this entire proposed constitutional amendment is on file in the office of the judge of the probate court and is available for public inspection.

provenance.sourceOrg: Georgia Secretary of State, Elections Division
provenance.quote: Shall the Constitution of Georgia be amended so as to require that all probate court judges be elected in nonpartisan elections?

measures.questionText: Shall the Constitution of Georgia be amended so as to authorize the General Assembly to dedicate certain existing revenues, including revenues reallocated by law, to a nonlapsing fund to be used exclusively for the expansion, maintenance, and operation of emergency 9-1-1 systems in this state?
measures.officialStatement: This proposal authorizes the General Assembly to provide by general law for the creation of the Georgia Next Generation 9-1-1 Fund . It amends Article III, Section IX, Paragraph VI of the Georgia Constitution, relating to appropriations to be for specific sums, by adding a new subparagraph (s). A copy of this entire proposed constitutional amendment is on file in the office of the judge of the probate court and is available for public inspection .
